aggregation.run_level: one prediction and one observed target per run/sequence
aggregation.design_level: for each design, calculate the arithmetic mean of its five realization targets and the arithmetic mean of its five realization predictions, then calculate RMSE, MAE, and R2 across designs
aggregation.residual_standard_deviation: population standard deviation for a complete reported population; explicitly record the denominator convention

uncertainty.undefined_metric_rule: If a resample has zero target variance, R2 is NaN for that replicate; report the valid-replicate count.

target_policy.reversibility_requirement: not applicable because no transformation is permitted
target_policy.test_use: test targets are used only for the single authorized final evaluation
